summary: host_group_vars options: _valid_extensions for vars files (.yml, .yaml, .json) and stage (all, task, inventory) controlling when the plugin runs, defaulting to RUN_VARS_PLUGINS.
questions: How do I add another valid extension for vars files?
When does the host_group_vars plugin run?

answer_card.title: host_group_vars parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `_valid_extensions` (`.yml`, `.yaml`, `.json`): affects vars_files, include_vars, inventory and vars plugins
- `stage`: `all` (after inventory and on task demand), `task`, or `inventory`; unset uses global `RUN_VARS_PLUGINS`
